name: Anne Comeaux Sutton
occupation: Teton County clerk of the district court (re-elected November 2026)
prior_offices: Teton County clerk of the district court (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Anne Comeaux Sutton is the Teton County clerk of the district court and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The Jackson Hole News&Guide reported that she, a Democrat, ran unopposed in the general election.
